song_story.overview: The title track from Love Yourself: Tear (2018), the album that pushed BTS's 'Love Yourself' series toward its darkest point. The whole Love Yourself arc is about learning to love yourself before you can love anyone else — and FAKE LOVE is the moment that lesson gets learned the hard way. The singer describes hiding pain to seem strong, faking happiness to seem fine, changing everything about himself for a partner, until he looks in the mirror and doesn't recognize who's left. It's not about a partner who lied — it's about a love built entirely on performance, on both sides.
song_story.cultural_root: The song sits on 가면 (mask) culture — the idea that Korean social life often demands performing an acceptable version of yourself, called 척하다 (cheokhada), 'to pretend/act as if.' 기쁜 척, 강한 척 — pretending to be happy, pretending to be strong — are the exact verbs the song builds its chorus around. It's a very Korean vocabulary for a very universal experience: erasing yourself to keep someone else comfortable.

verse_1.lines: 널 위해서라면 난 / 슬퍼도 기쁜 척 할 수가 있었어 / 널 위해서라면 난 / 아파도 강한 척 할 수가 있었어 / 사랑이 사랑만으로 완벽하길 / 내 모든 약점들은 다 숨겨지길 / 이뤄지지 않는 꿈속에서 / 피울 수 없는 꽃을 키웠어 / 세상을 줬네 just for you / 전부 바꿨어 just for you / Hey, 우리만의 숲 너는 없었어
verse_1.literal: If it was for you, I could / pretend to be happy even when sad / if it was for you, I could / pretend to be strong even in pain / wishing love could be perfect on love alone / wishing all my weaknesses could stay hidden / in a dream that will never come true / I grew a flower that could never bloom
verse_1.context: 널 위해서라면 uses -(ㄴ/는)다면, a strong hypothetical — 'if it were for you.' 피울 수 없는 꽃을 키웠어 — 'I raised a flower that can't bloom' — is the song's central image: investing everything in something structurally incapable of paying off.

pre_chorus.lines: 내가 왔던 route 잊어버렸어 / 나도 내가 누구였는지도 잘 모르게 됐어 / 거울에다 지껄여봐, 너는 대체 누구니? / 널 위해서라면 난 / 슬퍼도 기쁜 척 할 수가 있었어 / 널 위해서라면 난 / 아파도 강한 척 할 수가 있었어 / 사랑이 사랑만으로 완벽하길 / 내 모든 약점들은 다 숨겨지길 / 이뤄지지 않는 꿈속에서 / 피울 수 없는 꽃을 키웠어
pre_chorus.literal: I wanted to be a good man just for you / I gave you the world just for you / I changed everything just for you / now I don't know me, who are you? / hey, our forest — you were never in it / I forgot the route I came from / I don't even know who I used to be / spit it into the mirror — who are you, really?
pre_chorus.context: This is the turn from self-sacrifice to self-erasure. 우리만의 숲 너는 없었어 — 'our forest — you were never [really] in it' — is the realization that the relationship he built was partly imagined; the 'we' was mostly him.

chorus.lines: 널 위해 예쁜 거짓을 빚어내 / 날 지워 너의 인형이 되려 해 / 널 위해 예쁜 거짓을 빚어내 / 날 지워 너의 인형이 되려 해 / Why you sad? I don't know, 난 몰라 / 웃어봐, 사랑해 말해봐 / 나를 봐, 나조차도 버린 나 (Oh, no) / 너조차 이해할 수 없는 나 / 낯설다 하네, 네가 좋아하던 나로 변한 내가 / 아니라 하네, 예전에 네가 잘 알고 있던 내가 / 아니긴 뭐가 아냐, 난 눈 멀었어
chorus.literal: I'm so sick of this fake love / fake love, fake love / I'm so sorry, but it's fake love / fake love, fake love
chorus.context: The chorus is deliberately in plain English — blunt and repetitive where the verses are dense and poetic, like the one clear thought cutting through all the self-deception.

post_chorus.lines: 사랑은 뭐가 사랑? It's all fake love / Ooh, 나도 날, 나도 날 모르겠어 / 널 위해 예쁜 거짓을 빚어내 / 날 지워 너의 인형이 되려 해 / 널 위해 예쁜 거짓을 빚어내 / 날 지워 너의 인형이 되려 해 / 널 위해서라면 난 / 슬퍼도 기쁜 척 할 수가 있었어 / 널 위해서라면 난 / 아파도 강한 척 할 수가 있었어 / 사랑이 사랑만으로 완벽하길 / 내 모든 약점들은 다 숨겨지길 / 이뤄지지 않는 꿈속에서 / 피울 수 없는 꽃을 키웠어
post_chorus.literal: Love you so bad, love you so bad / I shaped a pretty lie just for you / love, it's so mad, love, it's so mad / I erase myself, trying to become your doll / love you so bad...
post_chorus.context: 예쁜 거짓을 빚어내 — 'I sculpt/shape a pretty lie' — 빚다 is the verb for molding pottery or making rice cakes by hand, giving 'lying' a strangely tender, crafted quality. 인형이 되려 해 — 'trying to become your doll' — is the clearest image in the song of losing personhood inside a relationship.

artist_context: FAKE LOVE is the centerpiece of BTS's Love Yourself: Tear album, which debuted at #1 on the Billboard 200 — the first Korean act to do so. The whole Love Yourself era (Her / Tear / Answer) traces one arc: infatuation, heartbreak from self-neglect, and finally self-acceptance, with this song marking the lowest point before the turn.
honorific_level: informal — 반말, delivered as internal confession rather than address to a partner

grammar_highlights.usage: 'To pretend to be/do.' 기쁜 척, 강한 척 — pretending to be happy, pretending to be strong. The verb that defines the whole song's theme of performance over honesty.
Shortened wishing form, as in 완벽하길, 숨겨지길 — 'wishing it would be perfect,' 'wishing it would stay hidden.' Compresses '바라다' (to wish) into a single ending for a wistful, unfinished-sentence feel.
'Trying to / about to.' 되려 해 = 'trying to become' — 인형이 되려 해, trying to become a doll, marks the moment self-sacrifice tips into self-erasure.
